Ring Front Door Knocker in Nickel Silver

text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH3192, Ring Front Door Knocker in Nickel Silver

Nickel Silver is a Michael Healy Designs original finish. It is created by combining a polished nickel finish with brushed accents for a modern look. This Nickel Silver Ring Door Knocker has a very now feel, making it a great choice for transitional decor homes. It is thru-bolt mounted meaning that the bolts come all the way through the door and are visible on the interior. The Ring Front Door Knocker in Nickel Silver has a 4 inch diameter.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Features and Specifications of the Traditional Ring Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Nickel Silver
  • Height: 4"
  • Width: 4"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 3-1/4"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-1/2"
  • Mounting: Thru-Bolt Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
